question.text:
Please select the best analysis of emotion for someone appearing in the image:

A. A sudden surge of surprise and curiosity overwhelms the individual as attention snaps to an unexpected event triggering a momentary pause and intense mental processing
B. A sudden wave of astonishment overwhelms with disbelief and shock triggering a reactive surge of awareness and emotional intensity
C. A sudden wave of shock floods through as unexpected information disrupts inner calm triggering an intense emotional reaction rooted in surprise and disbelief
D. A sudden surge of alertness overwhelms with a mix of fear and curiosity as the mind races to assess an unexpected threat while preparing for immediate action

Please provide the option letter of the most possible answer.

data.true_answer: A sudden wave of astonishment overwhelms with disbelief and shock triggering a reactive surge of awareness and emotional intensity
false_answers: A sudden wave of shock floods through as unexpected information disrupts inner calm triggering an intense emotional reaction rooted in surprise and disbelief
A sudden surge of surprise and curiosity overwhelms the individual as attention snaps to an unexpected event triggering a momentary pause and intense mental processing
